$comment: Every `#[ignore = "…"]` in the governed roots, with the issue that owns its fix. Written by `node scripts/check-ignored-tests.mjs --record`; checked by the same script without the flag, BOTH WAYS, so a rename or a deletion fails and so does a test the roster has never heard of. A bare `#[ignore]` is deliberately absent: those are time/soak opt-outs and make no claim about correctness. `node scripts/check-ignored-tests.mjs --check-issues` reads each named issue and fails when it is not OPEN. Read the diff before committing a re-baseline.
